target_analyses.name: completed_measurable_real_exists_version
target_analyses.objects: Arbitrary measure mu on an ambient measurable Omega, arbitrary information sigma field F, real map P.
target_analyses.premises: P measurable under eventuallyMeasurableSpace F (ae mu). No probability, finiteness, completeness of ambient measure, F<=ambient, or boundedness premise.
target_analyses.conclusion: An exactly F-measurable real function exists and equals P a.e. under mu. No uniqueness or equality everywhere.
target_analyses.definition_boundary: The supplied definition is modulo ambient ae-filter equality of sets. Since F<=ambient is not assumed, do not replace it with an unstated restriction/completion construction.
target_analyses.source_relation: No completion or measurable-version theorem appears on either page. Real-valued countable-determining-set reconstruction is added measure theory and must be proved/reused separately.

target_analyses.name: completed_predictable_exists_bounded_history_policy
target_analyses.objects: Arbitrary measure, seed and observations, family F_t<=seed-plus-past comap, real process measurable under the per-time modulo-ae structures.
target_analyses.premises: Per-time completed measurability and a.s. [0,1] prediction bounds. No probability, measurable seed/observations, IID, bounded observation, or increasing-F condition.
target_analyses.conclusion: One family of measurable all-domain [0,1]-valued seed/history policies reproduces prediction_t for every natural time on one full-measure event.
target_analyses.null_scope: For natural times, AE omega FORALL t and FORALL t AE omega are equivalent by countable intersection. Policies are chosen before this conjunction. Equality is not required at null outcomes or all possible histories.
target_analyses.source_relation: Source supplies game information order and past-only motivation. Completion, versions, factorization, private seed, all-history clamping and common a.e. event are added formal-model results.
target_analyses.zero_horizon: At t=0 the history is empty and only seed dependence is available. No horizon T occurs.

target_analyses.name: completed_predictable_private_seed_independent
target_analyses.objects: Probability space, independent measurable observation coordinates, measurable seed independent of full stream, a fixed t, F below seed-plus-past comap, completed-F-measurable P.
target_analyses.premises: Coordinate independence plus full-stream seed independence. Neither identical laws nor bounds on observations/prediction are assumed. F is not required to be part of a monotone filtration.
target_analyses.conclusion: P is independent of Y_t. This is not independence from past or from the full stream.
target_analyses.null_scope: A measurable version can be used, with independence transferred across a.e. equality. Null-set perturbations cannot be treated as changes in the distribution.
target_analyses.source_relation: An explicit probability bridge supporting the no-better oracle assertion. No such lemma is printed. The bounded policy targetT2 cannot be invoked wholesale because T3 does not assume boundedness.
target_analyses.zero_horizon: At t=0 seed-only information is independent of Y_0 by the full-stream seed premise.
target_analyses.alternative_note: I-JOINT+I-IMAGE via factorization and I-SIGMAFIELD are OR routes, not jointly required.

target_analyses.name: completed_predictable_private_seed_expectedFixed_excess
target_analyses.objects: Probability space; IID measurable a.s. [0,1] observations; measurable seed independent of full stream; completed-F_t-measurable, a.s. [0,1] predictions with F_t below seed-plus-past information; natural T.
target_analyses.premises: Identical laws, coordinate independence, per-time support bounds, seed-stream independence, information inclusion and completed measurability. No mean learner, no known conditional-loss identity, no increasing filtration, no supplied regret bound.
target_analyses.conclusion: expectedFixedRegret equals sum_{t<T} E[(prediction_t-EY_0)^2] and is nonnegative.
target_analyses.benchmark: expectedFixedMinimum is sInf of expected fixed comparator loss over u in [0,1]. Establish attainment at feasible mean, nonempty bounded-below image and value T variance; do not exchange infimum and expectation.
target_analyses.null_scope: For fixed T finite a.e. modifications suffice. A common all-time event from T2 is an optional route, not a necessary extra public hypothesis.
target_analyses.source_relation: Refines p1 mean benchmark and nonnegative assertion, but the exact identity, modulo-ae information model and sInf characterization are not printed. No empirical mean statement on p3 is a dependency.
target_analyses.zero_horizon: At T=0 the fixed-loss image is {0}; both equality and nonnegativity hold.
target_analyses.boundary: No sublinear convergence, logarithmic rate, pathwise guarantee, high-probability result or minimax statement follows merely from this target.
